description: This file defines FastAPI routes related to user authentication, including registration, login, and retrieving the current user's profile. It interacts with a Supabase backend for auth and profile data management.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Data model representing a user's profile, including ID, email, role, and optionally created_at.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: Data model for the authentication response, including access_token, token_type, and user profile.

classes.name: AuthLoginRequest
classes.description: Data model for login request payload, containing email and password.

classes.name: AuthRegisterRequest
classes.description: Data model for registration request payload, including email, password, and optional role.

methods.name: register(payload: AuthRegisterRequest)
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user in Supabase and a profile in the database.

methods.name: login(payload: AuthLoginRequest)
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returns an access token and user profile.

methods.name: me(user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's profile.
